text: A table of days plus troubleshooting bullets reads well and prints well, but it cannot remember which day you are on.
a2ui: A data-bound list of cards with a checkbox per day and a reminder button fits the catalog nicely; it cannot show progress or what the jar should look like.
html: Day picker, progress bar, an SVG jar that rises with activity and a feeding calculator, all custom; ticked days are lost on reload because the sandbox has no storage.
agui: Turns the how-to into a scheduling form, which is useful, but the instructions themselves are squeezed into a disabled two-column table with no room for the tips.
